sections.Profile:
The "El Toro" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corp. in August 1963, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Sports, Original Theme, Bullfighting
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Concept: Steve Kordek
- Art: George Molentin
sections.Editions: - El Toro: 1,850 made, released 1963-08-01, model number 284
